# Vælterne renterne aktiemarkedet - eller kan AI redde det hele igen?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-03  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish Millionærklubben episode from 3 September 2026 with Saxo strategist Oscar Bernhardsen and investor Steen Jakobsen, on whether rising global bond yields will topple equities or whether AI can keep carrying the market. Steen argues that as long as earnings stay strong, macro and rates (worrying only above about 5% on the US 10-year) are unlikely to derail stocks, and he prefers 'real economy' solution plays over high-margin AI names like Nvidia. Oscar sees an Iran-driven energy and freight tailwind for shipping and energy stocks, and prefers software over hardware within AI. Guest Henrik Carlsen reviews the Snowflake, Broadcom and Credo earnings.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NOW — ServiceNow | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Steen owns it (bought below 100, now about 140). Oscar prefers software over hardware and thinks the worst is over.

#### Reasoning

Steen (guest) sees ServiceNow as the essential enterprise platform for deploying AI agents, with GDPR and governance compliance, a 15-year workflow database, and about 15% recurring growth while its AI business is just starting. Oscar (guest) argues that SaaSmageddon fears were overdone, that adoption is accelerating, and that software gets rewarded for small beats.

#### Sell Triggers

- if enterprise AI adoption stalls
- if AI disruption of SaaS actually materialises

> *"Hvis Berlin skal lave en AI-agent, så er I nødt til at gå til ServiceNow"*

---

### ⛔ NVDA — Nvidia | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Steen won't touch it. Oscar is also skeptical despite the 70% growth guidance and roughly 20x P/E.

#### Reasoning

Steen (guest) thinks margins above 70% are hard to sustain, worries about circular financing and a backlog that depends on hyperscalers' ability to pay, and notes that tech funding costs now exceed mining's. Oscar (guest) flags that Nvidia's CDS doubled to 0.8% and doubts delivery, though he concedes the valuation looks reasonable if the guidance holds.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the 70% growth guidance is delivered and margins hold
- if hyperscaler financing costs fall

> *"Nej, jeg vil ikke røre den med en ildtang"*

---

### 🟢 DELL — Dell | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Steen praises the AI server growth, the $90bn backlog, the EPS beat, and conservative management with buybacks.

#### Reasoning

Steen (guest) sees Dell as supplying real enterprise AI adoption rather than hyperscaler speculation. Demand exceeds its capacity, and together with ServiceNow it covers core AI implementation. The risk is lower AI server margins from volatile component prices.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI server margins compress further
- if the backlog converts slowly

> *"de leverer et backlog på 90 milliarder dollars"*

---

### 🟡 SNOW — Snowflake | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Henrik holds a small, trimmed position. Strong report, but expensive after roughly tripling; long-term only.

#### Reasoning

Henrik Carlsen (guest, Horizon 3) cites three straight quarters of accelerating revenue, a 126% NRR, and growth in large customers. However, the stock trades near the top of the analyst price targets at about 15x sales, so it is not for a quick gain and only suits a long-term position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if revenue growth decelerates
- if net retention falls

> *"Det skal være en langsigtet position, tror jeg, hvis man skal ind i den."*

---

### 🟡 AVGO — Broadcom | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Henrik is a happy holder: AI revenue +221%, EBIT margin rising.

#### Reasoning

Henrik (guest) holds the stock. The results met expectations with 86% revenue growth. He thinks the gross margin dip comes from the higher mix of the lower-margin semiconductor business, and that EBIT margin is the better metric.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI revenue growth slows
- if EBIT margin falls

> *"Ja, det er sådan set"*

---

### 🟠 CRDO — Credo Technology | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Fell 20% despite a strong report and guidance. Henrik sees a possible overreaction but is neither buying nor selling yet.

#### Reasoning

Henrik (guest) says Credo supplies chip interconnects in datacenters, a fast-growing area, with expected growth of 85% this year and 55% next year. He thinks the 20% drop may be an overreaction but is still digesting whether something is wrong with the company.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the drop reflects fundamental problems

> *"det mener vi måske er en overreaktion"*

---

### 🟡 IBE — Iberdrola | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Steen is still positive: a bond-like, dividend-paying utility with an Iberian solar advantage, held as a core stability holding.

#### Reasoning

Steen (guest) holds it as a fixed-income substitute. Iberdrola has access to North African solar, and Spain and Portugal are growing fastest in Europe thanks to cheap energy input costs. He is a fan of European utilities in general.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the dividend is cut

> *"Absolut. I din portefølje skal du have noget, der ligner en fixed income"*

---

### 🟡 NORBT — Norbit | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Steen is still happy despite the weakness: a long-term structural story with strong owners and a NOK tailwind.

#### Reasoning

Steen (guest) says the owners are among Norway's largest shipping families, so capital is not an issue. The company has a unique position in underwater, port, radar and sonar monitoring, which fits his view that the 'real economy' 10% of value must grow.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the structural thesis in marine monitoring breaks

> *"det er en aktie, som er en del af løsningen inden for de 10 procent, og en, som jeg er meget glad for"*

---

### 🟢 PANW — Palo Alto Networks | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Oscar sees Palo Alto and CrowdStrike as the clean bet on cybersecurity after spending fatigue ended.

#### Reasoning

Oscar (guest) says the Anthropic Mythos model created a real AI threat that ended customers' spending fatigue. The largest players win the big contracts and consolidate the industry through M&A. He admits limited insight into how the companies differ.

#### Sell Triggers

- if spending fatigue returns

> *"Så skal man have et clean bet på hele industrien, så er det nok de to."*

---

### 🟢 CRWD — CrowdStrike | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Named with Palo Alto as one of the two dominant cybersecurity leaders and the clean industry bet.

#### Reasoning

Oscar (guest): the market leader consolidates the industry and wins large contracts as AI-driven threats boost security budgets.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cybersecurity spending slows

> *"Så skal man have et clean bet på hele industrien, så er det nok de to."*

---

### 🟠 DNORD — Norden | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Oscar: volatile energy prices and disrupted routes lift freight rates as the Iran conflict drags on.

#### Reasoning

Oscar (guest) says the tanker exposure benefits from energy volatility and route disruption, a small renaissance for the sector. This is contingent on the conflict lasting without fully halting shipments.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Iran conflict de-escalates
- if shipping lanes close completely

> *"Så det er derfor, de sidder foran en lille renaissance i de her dage."*

---

### 🟠 TRMD-A — Torm | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Tanker shipping benefits from higher, more volatile freight rates amid the Iran conflict.

#### Reasoning

Oscar (guest) points to the conflict-driven energy volatility and freight disruption that favour product tanker owners. The upside depends on how long the conflict lasts.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the conflict ends quickly

> *"Torm op næsten 3%, det samme med Norden."*

---

### 🟠 LNG — Cheniere | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Oscar watches this US LNG exporter as a solution to Europe's gas shortage; EU gas storage is at its lowest since 2022.

#### Reasoning

Oscar (guest): cheap US natural gas is liquefied at Texas hubs and shipped to Europe and Asia, where prices are soaring. A longer conflict and a cold winter would boost earnings. Steen (guest) sees the energy squeeze as transitory.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the conflict resolves
- if Europe has a warm winter

> *"jeg kigger meget på nogle af de amerikanske virksomheder, der kan være med til at lave en del af den her løsning"*

---

### 🟠 EQNR — Equinor | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Oscar: European energy producers benefit as gas prices more than double.

#### Reasoning

Oscar (guest) expects earnings to boom the longer the energy scarcity lasts. Steen (guest) counters that the energy shock is transitory.

#### Sell Triggers

- if gas prices normalise

> *"Equinor i Norge, som du ser, nyder rigtig godt af det her"*

---

### 🟢 CHEMM — ChemoMetec | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up 8% after a better buy recommendation from DNB (Carnegie). This is a cited analyst view, not the hosts' view.

#### Reasoning

The only basis is the analyst upgrade reported by Oscar. No independent thesis was offered by the panel.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the analyst recommendation is reversed

> *"Chemometek stiger 8%. Der er fået en bedre købsanbefaling fra DNB."*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Its CDS near 8% signals high credit risk among datacenter players.

#### Reasoning

Oscar (guest) says credit markets price smaller AI datacenter operators as high-risk credits even though equity markets treat them as risk-free. He sees this as a crack in the AI story.

#### Sell Triggers

- if CDS spreads tighten materially

> *"der betaler du altså på en credit default swap nu ... på næsten 8%"*

---

### ⛔ TSLA — Tesla | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Steen avoids 'fantasy story' stocks and says he has made a lot of money on Tesla betting against the story.

#### Reasoning

Steen (guest) does not buy stocks driven by narrative rather than fundamentals, and says Tesla is 'only a story' despite its revolutionary products.

> *"Tilsvarende har jeg også gået og klippet mange penge i Tesla, fordi det er jo kun en historie."*
